notes: The same conversation with the label lines 'You said' and 'Gemini said' (no colon) that an earlier review reported for Gemini chat pages. Unverified against a live page.

Apple knows these labels only with a colon, so the result is the same single assistant message labelled Claude. The web app accepts the two whole-line labels when BOTH occur in the text and splits the page into turns. The rule is built on a reported page layout, not on an observed one; if real pages differ it simply does not fire and the previous fixture applies.
